g.text: App Attest for a new account
anyone on the internet can send the request; identity is proven by the cookie, token or credential it carries
only workloads of the environment reach it; the caller is a known app or job, named in the headers it sends
only the environment reads or writes; a secret or a record lives here and nowhere else
Every F-number is a data flow the STRIDE tables cite.
